what: Grammatical sentences of benchmark v1.2 (data/benchmark/uzblimp.tsv, current Latin) found in the pretraining corpus of tomaris/Tomaris.ai
corpus: tomaris/fullcorpus on Hugging Face (private): tokenized parquet, 6 train shards and 1 validation shard of 2,048-token blocks; decoded with the tokenizer of tomaris/Tomaris.ai and searched as one text

match.strict: the whole sentence occurs verbatim after collapsing whitespace (case-sensitive)
match.loose: as strict after lower-casing, unifying apostrophe characters and dropping final punctuation (the normalisation of scripts/check_overlap.py)

note: The corpus is private, so this check cannot be repeated by readers. Only the grammatical member of a pair can occur in a corpus; paraphrases and near duplicates are not detected.
